description_en: Deletes a specified topic from a specified data source
description_zh: 调用该接口删除指定数据源下的指定Topic
name: DeleteDataSourceItem

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source topic. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/421072.html operation to query the list of topics in a specified data source and obtain the **DataSourceItemId**
parameters.help_zh: 数据源Topic的ID。您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/421072.html，查询指定数据源下的Topic列表，获取**DataSourceItemId**
parameters.name: data_source_item_id

parameters.help_en: The data source ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432676.html operation to query the list of data sources and obtain the **DataSourceId**
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID。您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432676.html，查询数据源列表，获取**DataSourceId**
parameters.name: data_source_id
